_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of CPH Airport (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Terminal 3 (check-in and arrival hall, street level); the 'station terminal' above the platforms
levels.name_source: Sund & Bælt, "Stations on the Øresund line", https://sundogbaelt.dk/en/road-and-rail-links/oresund/stations-on-the-oresund-line/, read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia, "Copenhagen Airport railway station", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen_Airport_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_dk, ODbL), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Danmarks Højdemodel, © Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/860000858).
Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 18 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000858).
